alert_deliveries_reason_when_suppressed.name: alert_deliveries_reason_when_suppressed
alert_deliveries_reason_when_suppressed.value: ("alert_deliveries"."status" = 'suppressed' AND "alert_deliveries"."suppressed_reason" IS NOT NULL) OR ("alert_deliveries"."status" <> 'suppressed' AND "alert_deliveries"."suppressed_reason" IS NULL)

alert_deliveries_recipient_when_email.name: alert_deliveries_recipient_when_email
alert_deliveries_recipient_when_email.value: ("alert_deliveries"."channel" = 'email' AND "alert_deliveries"."recipient_ref" IS NOT NULL) OR ("alert_deliveries"."channel" <> 'email' AND "alert_deliveries"."recipient_ref" IS NULL)

alert_rules_threshold_when_rank_drop.name: alert_rules_threshold_when_rank_drop
alert_rules_threshold_when_rank_drop.value: ("alert_rules"."type" = 'rank_drop' AND "alert_rules"."threshold" IS NOT NULL AND "alert_rules"."threshold" between 1 and 100) OR ("alert_rules"."type" <> 'rank_drop' AND "alert_rules"."threshold" IS NULL)

alert_rules_webhook_pair.name: alert_rules_webhook_pair
alert_rules_webhook_pair.value: ("alert_rules"."webhook_url" IS NULL) = ("alert_rules"."webhook_secret" IS NULL) AND ("alert_rules"."webhook_url" IS NULL) = ("alert_rules"."webhook_secret_last4" IS NULL)

alert_rules_webhook_url_length.name: alert_rules_webhook_url_length
alert_rules_webhook_url_length.value: "alert_rules"."webhook_url" IS NULL OR char_length("alert_rules"."webhook_url") between 1 and 2048

alert_rules_at_least_one_channel.name: alert_rules_at_least_one_channel
alert_rules_at_least_one_channel.value: jsonb_array_length("alert_rules"."email_recipient_ids") > 0 OR "alert_rules"."slack_webhook" IS NOT NULL OR "alert_rules"."webhook_url" IS NOT NULL

arsde_accepted_shape_check.name: arsde_accepted_shape_check
arsde_accepted_shape_check.value: ("audience_research_signal_decision_events"."decision" = 'accepted' and "audience_research_signal_decision_events"."destination" is not null and "audience_research_signal_decision_events"."downstream_id" is not null and "audience_research_signal_decision_events"."dismiss_reason" is null) or ("audience_research_signal_decision_events"."decision" = 'dismissed' and "audience_research_signal_decision_events"."destination" is null and "audience_research_signal_decision_events"."downstream_id" is null)

backlink_deep_snapshots_payload_check.name: backlink_deep_snapshots_payload_check
backlink_deep_snapshots_payload_check.value: jsonb_typeof("backlink_deep_snapshots"."payload") = 'array' and jsonb_array_length("backlink_deep_snapshots"."payload") <= case when "backlink_deep_snapshots"."type" = 'history' then 24 when "backlink_deep_snapshots"."type" = 'bulkRanks' then 100 else 500 end

kcde_accepted_requires_site.name: kcde_accepted_requires_site
kcde_accepted_requires_site.value: ("keyword_cluster_decision_events"."kind" = 'accepted' and "keyword_cluster_decision_events"."site_id" is not null) or ("keyword_cluster_decision_events"."kind" = 'dismissed' and "keyword_cluster_decision_events"."site_id" is null)

rank_drop_confirmations_reason_when_unco.name: rank_drop_confirmations_reason_when_unconfirmed
rank_drop_confirmations_reason_when_unco.value: ("rank_drop_confirmations"."state" = 'unconfirmed' AND "rank_drop_confirmations"."reason" IS NOT NULL) OR ("rank_drop_confirmations"."state" <> 'unconfirmed' AND "rank_drop_confirmations"."reason" IS NULL)

rank_drop_confirmations_positions_positi.name: rank_drop_confirmations_positions_positive
rank_drop_confirmations_positions_positi.value: ("rank_drop_confirmations"."candidate_position" IS NULL OR "rank_drop_confirmations"."candidate_position" >= 1) AND ("rank_drop_confirmations"."confirmation_position" IS NULL OR "rank_drop_confirmations"."confirmation_position" >= 1) AND ("rank_drop_confirmations"."previous_position" IS NULL OR "rank_drop_confirmations"."previous_position" >= 1)

scheduled_reports_cadence_fields_check.name: scheduled_reports_cadence_fields_check
scheduled_reports_cadence_fields_check.value: ("scheduled_reports"."frequency" = 'weekly' and "scheduled_reports"."weekday_utc" between 0 and 6 and "scheduled_reports"."monthday_utc" is null) or ("scheduled_reports"."frequency" = 'monthly' and "scheduled_reports"."monthday_utc" between 1 and 28 and "scheduled_reports"."weekday_utc" is null)
